name: keynote
about: The Apple keynote feature board: a 16:9 slide of 19 tiles in five columns (578 | 378 | 378 | 279 | 279) and three bands, small tiles stacked in pairs, the hero tile in the centre carrying the product name, a tall and a short tile down the right. Measured from Apple's iPadOS 26 board. Margins and gaps 18.

TL.role: big, top left: label on top, a UI or product visual bleeding off the bottom

T2a.role: wide small: label left, app icon right

T2b.role: wide small: label left, app icon or a pair of visuals right

T3.role: square-ish: a photo or full visual with the label over its top

T4a.role: small: label left, app icon right

T4b.role: small: label left, app icon right

T5a.role: small: label left, a tiny UI detail right

T5b.role: small: label left, a visual bleeding off the right edge

ML.role: medium: label on top, a UI panel (menu, message, card)

MS.role: narrow tall: label on top, two or three icons stacked

HERO.role: hero tile: the product name in huge type on a flat or photo background

RT.role: big, right: label on top, the richest UI visual

BL.role: tall small: label on top, a UI visual bleeding off the bottom or side

B2a.role: statement: two or three words in big colored type

B2b.role: small: label left, app icon right

B3.role: medium: label on top, a UI screen

B4a.role: wide small: label on top, one UI row (a progress pill, a notification)

B4b.role: statement: a short claim in big colored type

RB.role: wide, bottom right: label on top, a UI strip bleeding off the bottom; or the one accent tile
